# NSPanel HAUI 0.4.0

NSPanel HAUI 0.4.0 is the largest release since the ESPHome rewrite. One
prebuilt firmware now runs any panel — EU landscape or US portrait — and the
notification system was rebuilt around a queue that no longer loses a message.

This is the first stable release with breaking changes: read the
[upgrade guide](docs/upgrading.md) before you update.

## Before updating

- **Update both the firmware and the TFT** — both the ESPHome firmware and the
  Nextion TFT changed since 0.3.2. The release ships the universal prebuilt
  firmware `nspanel_haui.bin`: flash it, join the access point named after the
  device (e.g. `nspanel-haui-a1b2c3`, the MAC suffix keeps every AP unique) to
  enter your Wi-Fi, then add the device with the documented API key (see
  [Installation](docs/install.md)). On first connect after updating the
  integration, the display installs the matching TFT automatically (or asks,
  depending on `auto_install`).
- **Minimum Home Assistant version raised to 2026.10** — `hacs.json` now
  declares `2026.10` (0.3.2 declared `2026.5`). Home Assistant 2026.5–2026.9 no
  longer satisfy the requirement; update Home Assistant before upgrading. The
  integration targets the 2026.10 device/config-entry APIs and requires
  Python 3.14.
- **ESPHome 2026.10 or later is required** — the device configs set
  `min_version: 2026.10.0` and the release is built with a pinned ESPHome
  `2026.10.0` ([#59](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/59)).
- **HA service and display settings were renamed** — the idle-page service
  (`sleep` → `idle`) and the automatic display-off settings/entities now use
  the new vocabulary. No aliases are kept; update automations and dashboard
  entity references.
- **ESPHome API names changed** — the display actions and events use explicit
  display-on/display-off names, and notification actions are consolidated into
  one action with optional `persistent` and `text_size` variables.
- **Notification auto-dismiss was removed** — the `timeout` field is gone from
  `nspanel_haui.send_notification`, the ESPHome `send_notification` action/event
  and the `nspanel_haui.notification` event. Notifications stay in the queue
  until dismissed on the panel, replaced or cleared; queued notifications play
  through one popup after another. For alerts that must not be missed, use
  `persistent: true`: it loops the alert sound and re-opens its popup
  periodically until the notification is dismissed.
- **Saved panels are not migrated** — re-enter pre-0.4 panel settings in the
  editor and verify forecast type and panel navigation settings. The five
  renamed device-setting keys *are* migrated automatically (see *Fixed*).
- **Several compatibility paths were removed** — validation is required, YAML
  imports require the documented root shape, and color/template/function-button
  and vacuum battery configuration follow the current documented formats.

## New

- **Universal prebuilt firmware** (`nspanel_haui.bin`) — one binary for EU and
  US/portrait panels, provisioned over its open access point (Wi-Fi entered
  once at first boot). `name_add_mac_suffix: true` appends the last six MAC
  digits at runtime, so **one binary installs any number of panels**: each gets
  a unique hostname, mDNS name and setup AP without a per-device ESPHome build.
  Compiled and attached by the new release workflow, gated on the Nextion
  release checks.
- **Gesture navigation** — left/right swipes move through navigation panels, up
  opens About, down opens Settings. Named gesture sequences (timeframe,
  sequence, open target) are configurable in the editor and saved without a
  restart.
- **Device discovery** in the editor — **Device Manager → Scan** finds ESPHome
  devices on the network and offers to add them.
- **Configurable display auto-behaviour** — dimming, page transition and
  display-off timeouts per device (`timeout_dimming` / `timeout_page` /
  `timeout_display_off`).
- **Display-off schedule** (`use_sleep_schedule` / `sleep_schedule_start` /
  `sleep_schedule_end`) — a daily window during which `use_auto_display_off`
  may turn the display off after `timeout_display_off` seconds of inactivity;
  outside the window the display never turns off automatically (it only
  dims). The hub applies the schedule itself at every start, reconnect, save
  and window boundary, replacing automations that toggle the switch.
- **US display-model support** — `display_model` (`eu` / `us`) picks the
  matching TFT release asset and per-device US time/date formats
  (`%I:%M %p`, `%m/%d/%Y`). The US portrait TFT ships with the release
  ([#51](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/51)).
- **Notification services and entities** — the new
  `nspanel_haui.send_notification` service (`title`, `message`, `icon`, `type`
  (severity, with a default icon per severity), `persistent`, `force_show` and
  `text_size` fields), standard `notify.<device>` /
  `notify.<device>_persistent_notification` entities, the
  `nspanel_haui.reset_last_interaction` service, and the renamed `idle` service
  (was `sleep`).
- **Per-notification text size** — `text_size` (`"auto"` or a font size 1-3)
  on `nspanel_haui.send_notification` and the `send_notification` ESPHome
  action controls the popup font per notification
  ([#48](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/48)).
- **HA-native events** for automations: `nspanel_haui.page_changed`,
  `nspanel_haui.notification`, `nspanel_haui.connection_changed`.
- **Current-page string sensor** per device, for automation triggers (the
  internal numeric `page` sensor is unchanged).
- **Idle panel carousel** (`idle_panel_extra`) — each idle cycle advances to the
  next screensaver panel.
- **Vacuum battery sensor** option — point the vacuum panel at a dedicated
  sensor instead of relying on the deprecated battery attributes.
- **Alarm keypad styling** — font size, background and text colour per alarm
  panel.
- **Device Manager** view in the editor listing all NSPanels (online/offline,
  firmware/TFT versions, IP, signal strength) with add/remove/enable/disable
  and display refresh actions.
- **TFT update workflow** — the editor can trigger TFT installs per device
  (**Device Manager → Install TFT**; TFT installs remain automatic on connect,
  the button installs immediately) and shows the update state
  (`checking`/`installing`/`done`/`error` + version and last error) in the
  Device Manager and Device Info dialogs.
- **Firmware download** — **Device Manager → Download firmware** opens the
  prebuilt `.bin` of the latest release when one is attached, and explains the
  build-from-YAML path otherwise.
- **Panel Doctor** — device status now reports disconnect reason, offline-since,
  connection uptime and the integration version; the editor's Device Info and
  Device Manager dialogs surface them with a stale-data indicator.
- **Nextion release gate** — `scripts/verify_nextion/verify_nextion.py` blocks a
  release until `clock.tTime` reports taps (Send Component ID),
  `system.tftVersion` matches the integration version, and the portrait asset
  exists.
- **Thermostat/Climate panel** with setpoint adjustment.
- **`action` item type** to trigger HA automations / scripts from a panel
  button.
- **Editor conveniences** — preview thumbnails for every panel type in the
  editor grid view, an entity picker with search and domain filter, and toasts
  for save/delete/error events.
- **Installation docs** — dedicated flashing/installation documentation
  ([Installation](docs/install.md)).

## Changed

- **Device settings have one home** — `config_entry.data` holds only the hub
  identity and per-device identity; all settings and panels live in the panel
  store. One worker thread per device.
- **TFT auto-update on every connect** — the hub compares versions on every
  connect and installs the version the firmware needs (right away or after a
  display prompt, per `auto_install`).
- **Tapping the time advances the card** — `clock.tTime` now reports taps with
  its component ID (TFT 0.4.0).
- **Edge swipes follow the display model** — the hub syncs `display_model` to a
  firmware `Display Model` number, so portrait panels detect edge swipes on
  320×480 like landscape panels do on 450×320.
- **Startup sound** — plays only after a fresh boot, not on Wi-Fi reconnects.
- **Long notification messages are split into static pages** — the title shows
  a `(page/total)` counter and the header's left-secondary button advances to
  the next page; paging is manual — nothing advances on its own — and the
  button disappears on the final page, which stays visible, so long messages
  are read page by page instead of being truncated. Line breaks in the message
  are kept and long lines wrap at whitespace
  ([#49](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/49)).
- **Dark-theme refresh** with stepped surfaces (page `#101010` < header
  `#181818` < cards `#282828` < pressed `#313131`, text `#e0e0e0`), mirrored by
  the editor previews; both TFTs compile their content widgets with the new
  page colour, so text and buttons don't show as lighter boxes.
  Picture-background pages (About, Clock, Clock Two, Weather) skip the colour
  clear by design and keep their compiled picture; solid pages keep applying
  the device `background` override (see
  [Device settings](docs/configuration/device.md)).
- **Saving without a reload** — settings and panels save without reloading the
  hub; removed devices stay removed ("keep config" removal does not re-add
  them).
- **Device settings reach the firmware on save and on every connect** —
  config-sync and network-info reads resolve entities through Home Assistant's
  entity registry, so a panel renamed or given an area (as happens with the
  universal image) still gets its settings and health data.
- **`wakeup`** works without a wakeup panel.
- **Entity state** — climate, weather, row and QR pages follow their entities'
  state as documented.
- **Translations** — complete editor baselines for all five locales (`de`,
  `en`, `fr`, `nl`, `pl`).

## Fixed

- **Responsive panels** — one worker per device; touches, page changes and the
  heartbeat stay responsive (concurrency cleanup).
- **Actions** for services without a target run; page items behave as
  configured.
- **`hub_availability`** resets on the last disconnect (not on the first).
- **Stale values** — row pages visually flag stale entity values
  (`stale_data_seconds`).
- **Auto-dimming during popups** — popups pause auto-dim correctly on devices
  named with capitals or `-`.
- **Flat widgets** — text-bearing widgets on grid, row, select, notify and
  alarm-keypad panels sit flat on the page background; runtime painting no
  longer draws a lighter component box behind tiles, labels and keys.
- **Device settings from 0.3.x are migrated on upgrade** — the store loader
  renames the legacy config keys in place (`sleep_panel` → `idle_panel`,
  `sleep_panel_extra` → `idle_panel_extra`, `show_sleep_button` →
  `show_idle_button`, `use_auto_sleeping` → `use_auto_display_off`,
  `timeout_sleep` → `timeout_display_off`) and saves them back. Previously an
  unset `idle_panel` made the idle page and the header idle button silently
  no-ops, and auto display-off could not be toggled off from a stored
  `use_auto_sleeping`.
- **The notification indicator falls back to the idle button's slot** — when a
  panel claims both right header slots (grid/row pagination on the home panel,
  ...) and notifications are enabled, the notification indicator takes over the
  idle button's slot on the home panel so unread notifications stay reachable
  instead of disappearing.

## Issues addressed

- [#48](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/48) — per-notification
  text sizing. Thanks to [@quentinjourdan](https://github.com/quentinjourdan).
- [#49](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/49) — preserve
  notification line breaks and wrap long messages at whitespace. Thanks to
  [@quentinjourdan](https://github.com/quentinjourdan).
- [#51](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/51) — US portrait
  layout and touch mapping. Thanks to [@jsenecal](https://github.com/jsenecal).
- [#58](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/58) — fix the
  first-boot TFT download path so new panels can complete onboarding. Thanks to
  [@rhannink](https://github.com/rhannink).
- [#59](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/59) — clarify that
  ESPHome 2026.10 or newer is required. Thanks to
  [@artur90226](https://github.com/artur90226).

The broader notification wishlist in
[#50](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/50) remains open; this
release includes the separately tracked text-size and text-rendering fixes from
#48 and #49.
